content.comment_body: Hello, I am using [product_name] [version_no] on Windows 10. When working on my project, saving takes an extremely long time. Surprisingly, even a project with just a few buttons can result in a file size of around 500 MB. This is problematic since saving is required before transferring the project to the [product_name] hardware, which adds to the inconvenience. I've tested both 32-bit and 64-bit versions but noticed no improvement. Is anyone else experiencing this? Thanks for your assistance.
Hello [user_name], This forum communicates in English. Please use English in your future posts. Thank you.

analysis.insight_summary: The user faces very slow saving times and unexpectedly large project file sizes when using [product_name], even with simple setups. Saving is mandatory before transferring to hardware, increasing frustration. Switching between 32-bit and 64-bit versions on Windows does not resolve these performance and file size issues.
analysis.user_expectations: The user expects faster saving times and reasonable file sizes for projects, especially basic ones. They are also looking for an easier workflow from creation to transfer.
